request: Apply a discount code to a cart total in cents on a given day number. Codes are case-sensitive: SAVE10 takes 10% off (the discount is rounded down to whole cents) and is valid up to and including day 100; FIXED500 takes 500 cents off and never expires; HALF takes 50% off (discount rounded down) and needs a cart of at least 2000 cents. The result never goes below 0. An unknown code, an expired code, HALF on a smaller cart, or a negative total is invalid.

signature.python: def apply_discount(total_cents: int, code: str, day: int) -> int
signature.jig: def apply_discount(total_cents: int, code: str, day: int) -> Result[int, str]
